# video36 - L1 proxy, CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (round 001, initial scene)

Representation level: L1 (simple geometric proxies). Three.js sampled-frame baseline; not a Blender-protocol reproduction.

## Observed in the 24 reference samples
- One continuous handheld shot, letterboxed (~2.55:1 active area inside 16:9).
- 0-1.3 s: over-the-shoulder view behind a red-haired woman in a white towel (A) facing a wall mirror framed by green tiles; her blurred head at image left, her reflection at image right.
- ~1.3-2.9 s: fast whip pan to the left that settles on a doorway in a pink wall: a dark-haired woman in a red dress (B) stands in the doorway holding the right-hand jamb with her extended arm; blue hallway, beige panel and a far lit room behind her; towel shelf at left, sconce at right.
- ~3.3-4.5 s: B lets go of the jamb and leans/steps toward image left and toward camera.
- ~4.6-5.3 s: fast whip pan to the right back to A, now facing the camera with the mirror at image left (showing her back), tiles then a pink pillar and counter at right.
- 5.6-7.1 s: A looks toward image left, then grimaces with eyes closed.
- 7.4-8.6 s: A looks down with a hand at her chest while the background converges (camera retreats, A follows it); B re-enters from the image-right edge (~7.8 s) and moves behind A toward the right background; B also visible in the mirror.

## Reconstruction choices
- Geometry: box/cylinder/sphere room (pink walls, procedural green tile texture, banded black jamb, white trims, blue hallway, beige panel, dim far room with lamp, shower curtain proxy, counter, hand mirror, sconces).
- Mirror: an opening in the tiled wall that looks into a z-mirrored copy of the room and both people (group with scale z = -1 about the mirror plane), plus a faint haze plane.
- People: articulated proxies (hips, spine, neck/head, shoulders/elbows, hips/knees) - A with towel cylinders and auburn hair + bun, B with red dress, long dark hair block. B's left arm abducts to grip the jamb (1.65-3.3 s) then drops; A raises her right forearm to her chest and rubs (from 7.5 s). Simple analytic leg/arm swing while walking.
- Camera: fixed lens (horizontal tan half-fov 0.4), yaw/position/pitch keyframed with monotone cubic interpolation: whip left ~160 deg (1.3-1.9 s, decelerating to 2.97 s), whip right ~200 deg (4.6-5.3 s), slow retreat 7.0-8.6 s. Letterbox bars are camera-attached black planes.
- Lighting: hemisphere + ambient + point lights; the opening mirror segment is dimmed (light multiplier 0.38 before 1.35 s).

## Inference vs observation
Exact room layout, door position relative to the mirror, the people's paths while off-screen (B walking from the doorway around the camera's right; A turning around during the doorway segment) and the whip-pan intermediate directions are inferred. Motion blur of whip pans is not reproduced.

## Feedback
None received yet (initial round).

rounds.reason: Fix letterbox overdraw, darken mirror shot, hair/neck proxies, whip timing, 5.2 s framing, counter height, chest hand pose.
